cmp_Prereqs.inputs:
🚨  Final Prerequisite Check

With one week to go, you must already have working Sandbox access. If you do not, act today:

  1. Confirm you completed the TMS "EHRM Sandbox Login and Orientation Video" course (NFED #4686318).
  2. Confirm you received the provisioning email from VA-Account-Provisioning_US@oracle.com.
  3. Log in to your assigned Sandbox web portal to verify access now — do not wait for class day.
  4. If you still cannot log in, contact the VA EHRM Sandbox national team immediately.
